source.author: ov
source.text: nec tu aliud Vestam quam vivam intellege flammam, nataque de flamma corpora nulla vides.
source.text_original: nec tu aliud Vestam quam vivam intellege flammam, / nataque de flamma corpora nulla vides.
source.text_english: And do not understand Vesta as anything other than a living flame; and you see no bodies born from flame.
